title: Backbone-Specific LoRA Geometry: Orthogonality, Superposition, and Provenance
abstract: arXiv:2611.27201v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Sharing one low-rank adaptation (LoRA) update across pretrained models simplifies deployment. Composition methods typically combine updates from a common backbone, while cross-model transfer transforms updates for a target backbone. The conditions for sharing updates across backbones while preserving accuracy and distinguishing individual contributions remain unclear. Our idea is to use backbone-specific update directions as signatures of their training backbones. We derive a cross-backbone correlation bound from attention symmetries and equivariant LoRA learning under independent, uniform pretrained feature orientations. A local gradient-flow model explains positive mean correlation between independent runs on the same backbone and task. These patterns motivate cosine-based backbone identification and inner-product tests for registered-adapter reuse without coordinate alignment. translated_title: 主干网络特定的LoRA几何：正交性、叠加与溯源
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.27201v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：在预训练模型之间共享同一个低秩适应（LoRA）更新可以简化部署。组合方法通常合并来自同一主干网络的更新，而跨模型迁移则将更新变换以适配目标主干网络。在保持精度的同时跨主干网络共享更新、并能区分各自贡献的条件仍不清楚。我们的想法是将主干网络特有的更新方向作为其训练主干网络的签名（标识）。我们在独立且均匀的预训练特征方向假设下，从注意力对称性与等变LoRA学习推导出一个跨主干网络相关性上界。一个局部梯度流模型解释了在同一主干网络与任务上独立训练运行之间呈正的平均相关性。这些规律启发了基于余弦相似度的主干网络识别方法，以及无需坐标对齐即可对已注册适配器进行复用的内积检验。在CLIP主干网络上的实验表明，共享求和能够实现……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文将LoRA更新方向视为主干网络独特的“指纹”，通过推导跨主干网络相关性上界和局部梯度流模型揭示了正交性与叠加规律，从而实现基于余弦相似度的主干网络识别以及无需坐标对齐的已注册适配器复用检验。
en_tdlr: This paper treats LoRA update directions as backbone-specific signatures, deriving a cross-backbone correlation bound and a local gradient-flow model to enable cosine-based backbone identification and inner-product tests for registered-adapter reuse without coordinate alignment.
